verification_summary.balance_notes: SD15: Munoz 10 items (9 T1 pamphlet, 1 T3 OPB) plus 16 pamphlet endorsements; Hutchison 13 items (all T1 pamphlet), none endorsements (his statement prints none). Item counts comparable and both rely on pamphlet. Spot search: Munoz has more T3 coverage not collected (WW 2026-05-21, 2026-06-13 on the Sollman primary upset); Hutchison has a carrd.co site (T2, listed in pamphlet) not fetched by the collector. Collector effort looks roughly equal; both gaps note pamphlet-only positions.
